rawFindings.title: Loss of BOM and EOL escape processing in File.read
rawFindings.explanation: The original code in File.read method performed escape processing on the file content by default, using escapeContent which calls escapeBOM and escapeEOL, unless options.escape was false. The patch removes this logic and instead resolves with raw content string without escaping BOM or line endings. This breaks functionality that removes Byte Order Marks and converts Windows line endings to Unix style, causing different output from before.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the escapeContent call in File.read when options.escape is true, preserving the behavior of escaping BOM and line endings as in the original code.

rawFindings.title: Loss of BOM and EOL escape processing in File.readSync
rawFindings.explanation: Similarly to File.read, the File.readSync method originally escaped BOM and Windows line endings from the file content if options.escape was true. The patch removes this by returning the raw content string without running escapeContent, hence potentially breaking consumers relying on that unification of line endings and removal of BOM.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the check for options.escape and call escapeContent on the content string in File.readSync to maintain consistent behavior with File.read and previous code.

rawFindings.title: Removal of BOM and EOL escaping in File read methods
rawFindings.explanation: The previous code automatically escaped BOM and Windows EOL characters in file content by default in the read and readSync methods, using escapeBOM and escapeEOL utilities. This ensures consistent content formatting when reading files.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the calls to escapeContent on the content string to preserve the behavior of escaping BOM and Windows EOL characters in File.read and File.readSync methods.

rawFindings.title: Removal of default escape option in wrapReadOptions
rawFindings.explanation: The removed line that set options.escape = true by default alters the default behavior of the File reading functions. Without this default, the escape option defaults to undefined, and the escaping behavior does not occur even if escape is not provided by the caller.
rawFindings.suggestion: Re-add the line setting options.escape = true in wrapReadOptions to maintain the previous default behavior of escaping BOM and EOL characters.

acceptedFindings.title: Removal of BOM and EOL escaping in File read methods
acceptedFindings.explanation: The previous code automatically escaped BOM and Windows EOL characters in file content by default in the read and readSync methods, using escapeBOM and escapeEOL utilities. This ensures consistent content formatting when reading files.
acceptedFindings.suggestion: Restore the calls to escapeContent on the content string to preserve the behavior of escaping BOM and Windows EOL characters in File.read and File.readSync methods.

rawFindings.title: Reading file content no longer escapes BOM and EOL characters
rawFindings.explanation: The options.escape flag and the escapeContent function calls were removed from File.prototype.read method, causing returned content to no longer escape BOM and Windows line endings as before. This changes behavior and potentially breaks codes expecting escaped content.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the call to escapeContent(result) when options.escape is true in File.prototype.read.

rawFindings.title: Synchronous reading no longer escapes BOM and EOL characters
rawFindings.explanation: The File.prototype.readSync method no longer applies escapeContent to the read content, thus removing the previous behavior of escaping BOM and Windows line endings. This breaks existing contract and may cause unexpected results.
rawFindings.suggestion: Restore the call to escapeContent(result) when options.escape is true in File.prototype.readSync.
